WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_facetfaces
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_facetfaces
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_facetfaces) AS avg_site_facetfaces
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
kept AS (
  SELECT sa.avg_facetfaces, sta.avg_site_facetfaces, b.avg_facetfaces AS baseline_facetfaces
  FROM site_averages AS sa
  JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
    AND b.avg_facetfaces IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.avg_facetfaces > sta.avg_site_facetfaces
)
SELECT AVG(avg_facetfaces) AS average_kept_site_facetfaces,
       AVG(avg_facetfaces - baseline_facetfaces) AS average_difference_from_baseline,
       AVG(avg_facetfaces - avg_site_facetfaces) AS average_difference_from_status
FROM kept;
